faq.q: What is Rockridge Community Resource Center in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockridge Community Resource Center is a place listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Rockridge Community Resource Center confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Rockridge Community Resource Center as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Rockridge Community Resource Center?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Place type: not given. Scope: single site. Coordinates: not given. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Rockridge Community Resource Center information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Rockridge Community Resource Center, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Rockridge Community Resource Center?
faq.a: Most of it. Rockridge Community Resource Center rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Where it sits on the map and whether the player can go inside are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Rockridge Community Resource Center be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of landmark entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
